label: bounded exploratory falsification assays, not the decisive replay
scope: six explicit lengths for five n=5 structures; no n>=6 search
resources: single Python process per assay; no multiprocessing; no large downloads; existing scratch venv reused; numerical-library threads set1 when invoked

unsaturated_assay.promotion_requirement: Use the explicit integer separating functional, complete orbit enumeration, and threshold-coverage proof; do not trust Z3 UNSAT alone.

corrected_discovery_error: The initial separator-output comprehension used a symbolic Z3 inequality as a Python Boolean and raised Z3Exception after primal UNSAT and dual SAT had printed. Only the separator extraction was rerun, using string comparison with zero. This was a printing error, not a failed proof claim; the final certificate uses explicit integers and the decisive verifier does not import Z3.
